create_MCPPublicServer: create an MCPPublicServer Pydantic model with server_id, name, transport, and optional auth_type for public MCP servers
create_MCPCredentials: create an MCPCredentials TypedDict with OAuth2 client_id, client_secret, scopes or AWS SigV4 credentials
create_MCPStdioConfig: create an MCPStdioConfig TypedDict with command, args, and optional environment variables for stdio MCP servers
build_MCPPreCallResponseObject: build an MCPPreCallResponseObject with should_proceed, modified_arguments, and error_message for MCP pre_call_hook
build_MCPPostCallResponseObject: build an MCPPostCallResponseObject with mcp_tool_call_response list and hidden_params for MCP post_call_hook
